restaurantName: Transparence - La Table de Patrick Fréchin
bio: At Transparence, just a short walk from Place Stanislas in a busy pedestrian street, transparency is more than just a name – you can see chef Patrick Fréchin working his magic through the glass partition! His various set menus (including one dedicated to lobster) feature beautifully presented dishes that showcase excellent seasonal produce. There is a quiet terrace to the rear....
pageTitle: Transparence - La Table de Patrick Fréchin
